meta.description: Prepare for the ACT with adaptive practice, score tracking, weak area analysis, and college targeting.

copy.tagline: 备战ACT考试，自适应练习查漏补缺
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备ACT考试，想通过智能练习提升分数
copy.tagline_en: Prepare for ACT with adaptive practice and weak area analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing for the ACT and want targeted practice to boost your score

howto.what: 你好，我是你的ACT备考助手。我能帮你制定学习计划、跟踪各科分数进步、分析薄弱知识点，并基于你的分数推荐目标大学。
howto.when: 当你提到要准备ACT考试，或者询问ACT相关问题（如备考规划、提分策略、大学申请）时，我会自动接管。

say.text: 帮我制定一份6周ACT备考计划。
say.note: Claude会生成包含每日练习和复习的时间表。

say.text: 我数学总是超时，怎么改进？
say.note: Claude会分析错题原因并给出时间管理技巧。

say.text: 按我现在的分数，推荐一些目标大学。
say.note: Claude会匹配大学录取分数线和奖学金要求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes your ACT prep assistant. It creates study plans, tracks section scores, analyzes weak areas, and recommends target colleges based on your score.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention ACT preparation, ask about test strategies, or request college targeting based on ACT scores.

say_en.note: Claude outputs a daily practice schedule.

say_en.text: I always run out of time in math. Help!
say_en.note: Claude analyzes errors and suggests pacing tips.

say_en.text: Which colleges match my current score?
say_en.note: Claude matches scores with admission requirements.
